# go-mod-cache

Go modules downloaded for your projects. Go downloads them again when needed.

**Name:** Go module cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://go.dev/ref/mod#module-cache>

**Detected when** one of `go` is on PATH or one of `{modcache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{modcache}`: `go env GOMODCACHE` → `$GOMODCACHE` → default `~/go/pkg/mod`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{modcache}` | Go module cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:go-clean-modcache` |

## Native commands

- `native:go-clean-modcache` runs `go clean -modcache` (timeout 900 s, freed space measured before and after)
